feature: MiniMax H3 Director resolution, aspect, and input scaling panel

implementation_reference.fallback_scope: Auto aspect with no active image/video, including T2VA

input_scaling.auto_upscale: disabled; sources with a short edge of 2048px or less pass through unchanged
input_scaling.target_semantics: Stretch to the selected 16-aligned Director canvas
input_scaling.scope: Decoded image and video reference tensors only; audio passes through unchanged

external_dimension_overwrite.requirements: Both inputs must be present and positive; alignment is controlled by the upstream user
external_dimension_overwrite.behavior: Uses the external canvas, returns it via width/height, disables Director canvas calculations and input preprocessing

acceptance_criteria.requirement: A manual aspect selection recalculates width and height immediately, including without media.
Auto aspect uses the first active image or video dimensions immediately after it is added, removed, or reordered.
Auto aspect without visual media uses the MiniMax 4:3 fallback and Auto resolution yields 1024x768.
The selector visibly retains its selected preset rather than reverting to Auto.
The panel readout names the selected aspect and resolution and shows the resulting 16-aligned canvas.
Resolution state and canonical width/height widgets update through callbacks for workflow serialization and queue execution.
A third selector persists input_scaling in timeline_data.resolution and applies the included DaSiWa Torch Resize implementation to decoded image/video references before guide construction.
Focused Python/JS tests, JS syntax, Python compilation, and diff whitespace checks pass after the 4:3 fallback adjustment and input-scaling addition.

findings.detail: The select value was assigned before options were appended. Browsers can retain the first Auto option instead of the intended serialized value.
findings.resolution: Options are appended first, then the persisted value is assigned; input/change events update serialized state.

findings.detail: resolveCanvas returned null for Auto aspect with no visual media and for custom fixed pixels when no aspect could be resolved.
findings.resolution: Auto aspect now falls back to MiniMax 4:3 (1024x768 at the 768px short side), and fixed custom pixels resolve before aspect calculation.
